# Spaceson Labs

> Spaceson Labs is a small product studio. We build software products and AI automations for startups and small businesses in the US, UK and EU at a fixed price, with a working build every week, and run three paid products of our own. Remote, EU and US hours.

## Packages and prices (USD)

- AI Agent & Automation: from $1,000, one-off, no monthly fee. Live in 1–2 weeks. An agent that does a real job inside the tools your team already uses. Includes: short audit of the process first; 2–4 workflows plus the agent, connected to your email and CRM; alerts when something breaks; 30 days of tuning after go-live.
- MVP in 3 Weeks: from $500, fixed scope, fixed price. 3 weeks. A product people can sign up for and pay in, on phone and desktop. Includes: sign-in and card payments; admin panel, landing page, analytics; a working build every week; two rounds of changes; code and IP yours after final payment.
- Product Engineering on Demand: from $3,000/mo, monthly, scale up or down. Start within a week. A senior frontend and full-stack engineer inside your own team. No hiring, no long contract.

Also: Telegram bots and Mini Apps.

## Proof: products we run

- InboxSieve (https://inboxsieve.com/): sorts website contact-form messages, removes spam, scores real client requests 0–100 and drafts a reply. Free plan, paid from $5/mo. Live since 21 Nov 2026.
- PriceDawn (https://pricedawn.spacesonlabs.com/): checks competitors' prices once a day and sends one email at 7:00 with every change. From $9/mo. Live since 21 Nov 2026.
- MonthMemo (https://monthmemo.spacesonlabs.com/): writes each marketing agency client's monthly website report; the agency approves before it is sent. From $9/mo, first month free. Live since 21 Nov 2026.

## Contact

Email hello@spacesonlabs.com with a few lines about what you want built. You get a one-page plan with scope, timeline and one price within 24 hours.
